notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Approvals waiting for you, your finished runs and budget alerts.

items.approvalNeeded: {stage} for “{topic}” is ready for your review.
items.approvalExpiring: {stage} for “{topic}” expires {expiresAt}. Decide before the run is cancelled.
items.runRejected: “{topic}” stopped because a stage was rejected.
items.runPaused: “{topic}” is paused because the lab's OpenRouter balance is used up. It continues by itself after a top-up.
items.budgetWarning: You have used {percent}% of your LLM budget for {month}: {spent} of {budget}.
items.budgetExhausted: Your LLM budget for {month} is used up ({spent} of {budget}). Your runs continue on free models.
items.unknown: Something changed in one of your runs.

notifications.emptyDescription: Approvals waiting for you, finished runs and budget alerts appear here.
notifications.olderUnread: {count, plural, one {# older unread notification is} other {# older unread notifications are}} not listed here. Mark all as read covers them too.
